locks: Canonical pack lock, pack root, then global Control roots and ControlVersion rows in ascending UUID order; re-read snapshot and CAS after reference locks
population_hash: Existing P1 profile, also exclude lifecycle/transition metadata from exact reference Control/ControlVersion and the two own mapping populations. Content/identities/relationships/editions remain in the hash. No old receipt hash is converted.
etag: P1 profile plus reference Control/ControlVersion and own mapping current lifecycle states, ordered by canonical IDs
approval_binding: All changed reference objects must already be included in population_hash and covered by the actual current source/edition/package/coapprovals. This is not tenant control implementation.
audit: Single canonical publication audit includes every affected reference ID and its before/after lifecycle; unchanged published references are recorded without UPDATE. Canonical outbox event/result schema remain intact.
